model: tM series digital I/O modules tM-P4C4, tM-C8, tM-P8 (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: tM-P4C4 (4 DI + 4 DO), tM-C8 (8 DO) and tM-P8 (8 DI) with the Modbus RTU protocol selected, per the tM Series DIO User Manual Rev A1.4.
summary: ICP DAS tM modules are small DIN-rail RS-485 I/O modules that speak DCON or Modbus RTU. The DIO models covered here give digital outputs as coils, digital inputs as discrete inputs, 16-bit input counters, latch bits and module settings. Only the channels a model actually has respond.

addressing.note: The address table uses Modicon numbers (00001, 10033, 30001, 40481). The function-code sections give the matching wire addresses: DO readback starts at 0x0000 (00001), DI at 0x0020 (00033/10033), latch clear at 0x0107 (00264) and counter clear at 0x0200 (00513). Subtract 1 from the 5-digit number.

source.title: tM Series DIO User Manual
source.pages: pp. 109-117 (Modbus function codes and valid addresses per module), pp. 133-134 (address mapping table)

notes: Channels are listed 0-7. tM-P4C4 has DO0-DO3 and DI0-DI3, tM-C8 has DO0-DO7 only, tM-P8 has DI0-DI7 only; each function-code section lists only the channel addresses valid for each model.

Supported function codes are 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 15 and 70 (module settings). There is no 06 or 16, so the holding registers 40485-40492, although marked R/W in the table, cannot be written with standard Modbus writes; they are listed as read only. Change settings with the DCON utility or function 70.
Counters are 16-bit (maximum 65535) and can be read with function 03 or 04.

DI latch values are listed as coils (00065-00072 high, 00097-00104 low) because function 01 accepts 0x0040/0x0060 while function 02 accepts only 0x0020-0x003F; the table's 10065/10097 copies are not listed. Latched DO values (00073-00080, 00105-00112) are left out.
Firmware version and module name (40481-40484, low word first) are left out because their encoding is not described.
In INIT mode (INIT switch) the module starts at address 00, 9600 bps, DCON protocol, for recovery.

The address table marks the safe-value, power-on-value and settings coils R/W, but the function 05/15 sections list only the DO channels, 0x0107 and 0x0200+ as valid outputs. If a write to a settings coil is refused, use the DCON utility or function 70.

integration.summary: Switch the module to Modbus RTU, then read inputs with function 02 from wire 32 and drive outputs with function 05 at wire 0-7. Counters are on function 04 from wire 0.
integration.enable: Factory default is already Modbus RTU, address 1, 9600 bps. Coil 00257 switches between DCON and Modbus; address and baud changes are made with the DCON utility or function 70.
integration.watchdog: Host watchdog: enable with coil 00261, timeout 0-255 x 0.1 s in 40489. On timeout the outputs go to their safe values (00129-00136); clear the timeout status with coil 00270.
quirks: No function 06/16: use 05/15 for coils; settings registers are read only over standard Modbus.
Inputs can be read as coils (00033+) or discrete inputs (10033+).
setup: Address 1-247 and baud/parity are module settings (40485/40486); use the DCON utility, function 70 or INIT mode to change them.
gotchas: Each model accepts only the channel addresses listed for it in the function-code sections.
Counters are 16-bit with a maximum of 65535.
After a host watchdog timeout the outputs hold their safe values and ignore DO writes until the timeout status (coil 00270) is cleared; the status survives a power cycle.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
